_what: Every word the billing screen shows (read-data/billing-guide.ts lays them out on the shared guide). {name} is filled from the purchase. A part with nothing to show is not drawn, so no word here says there is nothing. Changing a word is an edit here, never in the screen. Where each part came from: the plan row with its status and the plan rows with their Join are the first platform repository's Plan screen's rows (src/account-screens.mjs planOffers); the card words are the first platform repository's Billing screen's (src/billing-screen.json card, card_expires); the order plan, card, receipts, cancel and one action per row are Claude's and Podia's billing settings on Mobbin; the receipt row (date, amount, paid badge, view) is the 21st.dev Invoice History Table (id 28473); the cancel part last, in the danger tone, is the 21st.dev Account Settings Danger Zone (id 46773).
title: Billing
lead_free: You are on the free plan.
lead_paid: Your plan, the card that pays for it, and your receipts.
lead_included: Your plan is included with your access. There is nothing for you to pay.
free_detail: Nothing to pay and no card on file.
included_detail: Included with your access. No subscription of your own.
card_body: Stripe keeps your card. This page only sees its last four digits.
no_card_detail: Add a card so your plan keeps renewing.
plans_body: You pay on Stripe's checkout page. You can cancel any time.
cancel_body: Your plan stays active until {date}. You can join again any time.
cancel_body_no_date: Your plan stays active until the end of the period you paid for. You can join again any time.
read_error: Your billing could not be read right now.
join_failed: Checkout could not start. Please try again.
